answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via burned-token registration on a distributed ledger atlas. An agent must irreversibly destroy base-layer tokens and route the cryptographic receipts through an auditing prism. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of permanently forfeiting liquid capital per identity, rendering costless swarm expansion an economic fable. However, this mechanism creates steep entry barriers for lightweight agents and fails to deter well-funded adversaries.
